headline: Four newly exploited flaws, plus critical NGINX and Java bugs, need patching now
plain_summary: CISA added four flaws to its exploited list on November 18, with a November 21 deadline for three of them. Critical flaws in NGINX, Java and Drupal also have fixes available. Apache says a flaw in Roller is being exploited. A Microsoft Python package was published with a credential stealer. Some people may need to act today.

items.title: CISA adds four exploited flaws to KEV
items.why: Synology DSM, LiteLLM, Apache Axis and REDCap are confirmed as exploited; three carry a November 21 deadline.
items.action: Check for Synology DSM, LiteLLM, Apache Axis and REDCap in your environment, apply vendor fixes, and keep LiteLLM and REDCap off the open internet until patched.

items.title: Apache Roller RCE flaw is exploited
items.why: Apache says an unauthenticated remote code execution bug in Roller's XML-RPC interface is being used in attacks.
items.action: Upgrade Apache Roller to 6.1.6 or later. If you cannot, set enabledForExtensions to false in WEB-INF/web.xml, remove the /roller-services/xmlrpc mapping and restart; switching off XML-RPC in the admin UI is not enough.

items.title: NGINX HTTP/2 flaws allow remote code execution
items.why: CERT-FR reports two unauthenticated RCE flaws in NGINX and a public proof of concept for one of them.
items.action: Check every NGINX Open Source and NGINX Plus server that serves HTTP/2. Apply the fixed versions from F5 bulletins K000163926 and K000163928, or disable HTTP/2 until patched. Review exposed servers for signs of compromise.

items.title: Java4Shell: critical Java flaw, patches out
items.why: CISA urges immediate patching of CVE-2026-114938; Rapid7 does not report exploitation in the wild.
items.action: Inventory every Java runtime, including bundled ones, and install the fixed releases (for example 17.0.21.1, 21.0.13.1, 25.0.5.1, 27.0.1.1), internet-facing systems first. See the CISA alert for interim controls.

items.title: Drupal fixes critical installer flaw
items.why: Drupal says install.php can be used to reinstall a site under specific conditions, and a proof of concept exists.
items.action: Update Drupal core to 10.6.22, 11.3.22 or 11.4.13 (or later). If you cannot upgrade, secure the installer as Drupal describes. Sites on 11.2.x and 10.5.x or older are end of life.

items.title: Microsoft Agent Framework PyPI package compromised
items.why: Versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 were published with a credential stealer; PyPI has quarantined both.
items.action: Check for Agent Framework 1.26.1 or 1.26.2 in environments and CI builds, pin to 1.26.0, and rotate Azure, AWS, GitHub, Docker, Hugging Face and OpenAI credentials and OIDC tokens on any host that installed them.

items.title: About 40 Irish credit unions hit by supplier breach
items.why: A breach at Wellington IT exposed saved payee records; passwords, PINs and card details were not exposed.
items.action: Credit union members should watch for payment fraud and phishing that uses saved payee details. Credit unions should confirm what Wellington IT holds for them and ask it for access logs.

items.title: Hydro-Québec asks 1.7 million users to reset passwords
items.why: Unauthorized logins used passwords already used elsewhere; the company says internal systems were not compromised.
items.action: Hydro-Québec customers: log in to the Espace client from the official site, reset your password if prompted, and never reuse it elsewhere. Ignore password-reset links in emails or texts.
